about: New York City congressional districts, 55th (1897) to 107th (2003) Congress. Lines: Jeffrey B. Lewis, Brandon DeVine, Lincoln Pitcher and Kenneth C. Martis, Digital Boundary Definitions of United States Congressional Districts, 1789-2012 (https://cdmaps.polisci.ucla.edu/), New York districts clipped to the five boroughs. Members: @unitedstates congress-legislators (term start and end dates). District 0 = elected at large (statewide).
